variants.control: Identical reference function in the same binary
variants.direct: Prior direct-address LUT candidate, scoped to aligned two-row jobs
variants.tile: Two input rows by two outputs, with direct LUT and shared activation loads. Aligned two-row jobs only.

model.controls: Reference and control are identical for all cases. All four modes share the prefill and one-session paths.
model.report: Retain every round, report medians and ranges of within-round ratios. Normalize elapsed decode and role spans per call for displayed milliseconds.

kernel.report: Compare direct and tile to reference within each round for each shape and worker count. Report same-path controls and all ratios.

advance_gate: Bitwise parity and matching workspace required. Two-session decode median of four within-round ratios at most 0.95, with at least three of four ratios below one. One-session decode and prefill median ratios at most 1.05. A same-path median outside 0.95–1.05 limits the run to exploratory evidence. This is a screen for a follow-up confirmation.
